parameter_matrix.note: Op-amps (internally compensated for linear feedback) and comparators (uncompensated open-loop switching) are NOT drop-in interchangeable.
Single SOT-23-5 op-amps vary in pin ordering across vendors; verify Pin 1–5.
A part wins only if its recommended Vs range strictly encompasses the counterpart on both ends.
Exceeding Vs,abs causes immediate gate-oxide or junction breakdown.
Closed-loop -3 dB bandwidth scales as f_-3dB = GBWP / Acl.
Controls large-signal full-power bandwidth SR / (2π·Vpeak) or comparator switching speed.
Lower Vos minimizes DC error in current-shunt and sensor bridge amplifiers.
CMOS/JFET pA-class inputs avoid offset voltage drops across high-impedance (>100 kΩ) sensors.

RRIO prevents clipping on low-voltage 3.3 V single-supply ADC buffers.

swap_risks: CAUTION BANDWIDTH & PHASE MARGIN: GBWP differs by 10x (TLV9001IDBVR: 1 MHz p.17 vs TLV9061IDBVR: 10 MHz p.13); higher-bandwidth replacements can oscillate with capacitive loads or stray feedback capacitance without an isolation resistor.
CAUTION SLEW RATE DIFFERENCE: Slew rate differs by 3.3x (TLV9001IDBVR: 2 V/µs p.17 vs TLV9061IDBVR: 6.5 V/µs p.13); check full-power bandwidth SR / (2π·Vpeak).

HIGH INPUT BIAS CURRENT SHIFT: Typical Ib differs by 10x (TLV9001IDBVR: 5 pA p.17 vs TLV9061IDBVR: 0.5 pA p.13); high-impedance sensor dividers (>100 kΩ) suffer severe Ib·R DC offset error when swapping from CMOS/JFET to bipolar inputs.

CAUTION QUIESCENT CURRENT SHIFT: Supply current per channel differs by 9x (TLV9001IDBVR: 60 µA/ch p.18 vs TLV9061IDBVR: 538 µA/ch p.14); verify battery budget and total power dissipation across all channels.
engineering_verdict: TLV9001IDBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) and TLV9061IDBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required alternatives: the PCB land pattern is compatible, but passive retuning or rating derating is mandatory because GBWP differs 10x; slew rate differs 3.3x; input bias current Ib differs 10x (CMOS vs bipolar input stage). Signal-chain deltas: GBWP 1 MHz (p.17) vs 10 MHz (p.13), supply ceiling 5.5 V (p.14) vs 5.5 V (p.10), Vos 1.6 mV (p.17) vs 1.6 mV (p.13), Ib 10x gap (5 vs 0.5 pA), voltage noise 30 vs 16 nV/√Hz. Primary bench gotchas to watch: TLV9001IDBVR "Critical SOT-23-5 Suffix Trap: TLV9001IDBVR vs TLV9001UIDBVR Pinout Swap" (p.7) and TLV9061IDBVR "SOT-23-5 (DBV) Pinout Matches TLV9001/OPA333 DBV — Differs from SC70 (DCK) & U-Variants" (p.5). BOM decision: Choose TLV9001IDBVR when ultra-low supply current (60 µA/ch) is prioritized; choose TLV9061IDBVR when closed-loop signal bandwidth requires 10 MHz GBWP. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.7 vs TOP_VIEW p.5) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
